title: Playoff Bubble Panic & Fraud Exposure Special
subtitle: Week 11 Blowouts, 33-Move Meltdowns, and Jordan's Fire Sale
leagueName: Don't you want a fanta fanta fantasy league?
summary: Scoop Sullivan, Johnny Two-Screens, and Dr. Metric dissect a savage Week 11 featuring five 30-plus point blowouts, K9 KenBoned cruising to 11-0, ItsOurYear dropping a 140.94 bomb, Loud Submitters imploding despite 33 moves and a blockbuster RB trade, and total chaos on the six-team playoff bubble.
highlights: ItsOurYear explodes for a league-high 140.94 to crush unluckiest loser Hall Pass by 55.2 points
Undefeated K9 KenBoned moves to 11-0 with a 102.66 to 50.74 demolition of jordanzfinci
Luckiest winner Drake it til you make it steals an 80.22 to 56.46 win over Loud Submitters
Absentee Pretty Pattys makes only two moves all year and shocks second-place The Boutte Warriors 116.96 to 80.84
StevenStrybos earns Biggest Bench Blunder by sitting Fernando Mendoza and his 22.88 points
Blockbuster Week 11 trade sends Kyren Williams and Rhamondre Stevenson from jordanzfinci to Loud Submitters for draft capital

segments.speaker: Beat Reporter
segments.text: Welcome to Week 11 of Don't you want a fanta fanta fantasy league, our Playoff Bubble Panic and Fraud Exposure Special! I am Scoop Sullivan, flanked by Johnny Two-Screens and Spencer Dr. Metric Vance. Five of six games ended in thirty-plus point murders, and the playoff race just exploded.
segments.act: Act I: Cold Open & Headline Chaos

segments.speaker: Comedian
segments.text: [laughs] Exploded? Scoop, Week 11 was a public execution! Not a single matchup finished within twenty points. Half this twelve-team Half PPR league completely forgot how football works while K9 KenBoned struts around at 11 and 0 like Thanos holding a cold soda and laughing at mortals.
segments.act: Act I: Cold Open & Headline Chaos

segments.speaker: Analytical Guru
segments.text: The scoring distribution this week was genuinely grotesque. The league average landed at 88.5 with a median of 83.29, yet five squads face-planted beneath the median while two rosters cleared 116. When volatility spikes this violently in Week 11, our entire six-team playoff bubble screams violent regression.
segments.act: Act I: Cold Open & Headline Chaos

segments.speaker: Comedian
segments.text: Relax, TurboTax, nobody cares about your precious bell curve when jordanzfinci, our beloved Man-Egg-Ghost-Three squad, barely crawled past fifty points! 50.74! You could draft blindfolded at an Applebee's bar during happy hour and accidentally stumble into sixty points without breaking a sweat.
segments.act: Act I: Cold Open & Headline Chaos

segments.speaker: Beat Reporter
segments.text: Hold your flamethrower, Johnny, because my Pentagon-level sources confirm Jordan's Man-Egg-Ghost-Three squad actually detonated his own roster in a blockbuster Week 11 trade! Before we raid the transaction wire, let us inspect the wreckage from our biggest massacre and our most hilariously ugly thriller.
segments.act: Act I: Cold Open & Headline Chaos

segments.speaker: Beat Reporter
segments.text: [excited] Opening Act Two with our Biggest Blowout of Week 11! ItsOurYear, led by collinshaw, obliterated Hall Pass by 55.2 points, dropping a league-high 140.94 to 85.74. Running back Chuba Hubbard went ballistic for 26 points to spearhead an absolute merciless massacre that rattled the entire league.
segments.topic: Biggest Blowout: ItsOurYear vs Hall Pass
segments.act: Act II: Marquee Massacre & Cardiac Thriller

segments.speaker: Comedian
segments.text: 140.94! Collinshaw woke up sitting at 5 and 6 and chose pure, unfiltered violence! Meanwhile, poor Hall Pass falls to 3 and 8 despite scoring 85.74, which beat the league median! That is like wearing your nicest suit to a wedding and getting hit by the catering van.
segments.act: Act II: Marquee Massacre & Cardiac Thriller

segments.speaker: Analytical Guru
segments.text: Mathematically, Hall Pass is our official Unluckiest Loser of Week 11. Posting 85.74 beats half the league, yet JkHood walked directly into a buzzsaw. Worse, Hall Pass left Ted Hurst III and his 20.1 points on the bench while starting Luther Burden III for a painful 2.3.
segments.act: Act II: Marquee Massacre & Cardiac Thriller

segments.speaker: Beat Reporter
segments.text: Now for our alleged Cardiac Thriller, the closest game of Week 11, which still finished with a massive 23.76 point margin! Drake it til you make it defeated Loud Submitters 80.22 to 56.46, leaving both EverettWood and wbruner99 deadlocked in the standings at 7 and 4.
segments.topic: Closest Game: Drake it til you make it vs Loud Submitters
segments.act: Act II: Marquee Massacre & Cardiac Thriller

segments.speaker: Comedian
segments.text: [scoffs] Closest game?! That was two exhausted uncles wrestling over the final mozzarella stick at midnight! Loud Submitters coughed up 56.46 points! Jordyn Tyson gave wbruner99 1.5 miserable points while Antonio Williams lounged on the bench with 16.7. That game belonged behind a parental warning label.
segments.act: Act II: Marquee Massacre & Cardiac Thriller

segments.speaker: Analytical Guru
segments.text: [sighs] This matchup physically offends my spreadsheets. Drake it til you make it is our undisputed Luckiest Winner of Week 11. Jahmyr Gibbs dragged EverettWood across the line with 25.8 points, and their 80.22 score fell beneath the 83.29 median, yet they still walked away smiling.
segments.act: Act II: Marquee Massacre & Cardiac Thriller

segments.speaker: Beat Reporter
segments.text: Time for our Around the League Matchup Blitz! First, undefeated juggernaut K9 KenBoned stormed to 11 and 0 by humiliating jordanzfinci 102.66 to 50.74, a ruthless 51.92 point demolition. Wide receiver CeeDee Lamb paced jdub7517 with 24.7 points while Man-Egg-Ghost-Three posted the lowest score of Week 11.
segments.act: Act III: Around the League Matchup Blitz

segments.speaker: Comedian
segments.text: [laughs] 50.74! Jordan's Man-Egg-Ghost-Three squad dropped to 6 and 5 while starting Ryan Flournoy for 1.6 points! Meanwhile, Ladd McConkey sat on the bench screaming with 18.2 points. Plugging Ryan Flournoy into your lineup against an 11 and 0 buzzsaw should carry a mandatory thirty-day jail sentence.
segments.act: Act III: Around the League Matchup Blitz

segments.speaker: Analytical Guru
segments.text: Next up, a seismic upset that broke my efficiency dashboard. Four and seven Pretty Pattys dismantled eight and three The Boutte Warriors 116.96 to 80.84, winning by 36.12 points as Jonah Coleman erupted for a jaw-dropping 32.9 points to shock zwood92 and the entire playoff race.
segments.topic: Pretty Pattys vs The Boutte Warriors
segments.act: Act III: Around the League Matchup Blitz

segments.speaker: Comedian
segments.text: Wait a minute! Pretty Pattys manager zpendy is our least active manager with literally two moves all season! Two! The man logs in once a quarter and still humiliated the two seed while DK Metcalf handed Boutte Warriors 0.7 points and Jayden Daniels sat with 17.06!
segments.act: Act III: Around the League Matchup Blitz

segments.speaker: Beat Reporter
segments.text: Over in Matchup Five, andyehlert moved to 5 and 6 by flattening four and seven Sully1of1 106.3 to 73.46, a convincing 32.84 point rout. Quarterback Dak Prescott torched the scoreboard for 35.9 points, delivering the single biggest individual explosion across the entire league in Week 11.
segments.act: Act III: Around the League Matchup Blitz

segments.speaker: Comedian
segments.text: [scoffs] And Sully1of1 countered that Dak nuke by starting Blake Corum for an actual goose egg, zero point zero! Imagine eating a donut while Mike Evans sits right there on your bench dropping 19.9 points! Even TurboTax knows you never bench Mike Evans for zero.
segments.act: Act III: Around the League Matchup Blitz

segments.speaker: Analytical Guru
segments.text: Thank you, Johnny, I appreciate basic expected-points sanity. Wrapping our blitz, four and seven Cowboys buried two and nine StevenStrybos 104.2 to 63.5, a brutal 40.7 point beatdown. Ashton Jeanty rumbled for 25.4 points as dmcburney kept faint mathematical playoff hopes breathing for another week.
segments.act: Act III: Around the League Matchup Blitz

segments.speaker: Beat Reporter
segments.text: Act Four brings Bench Crimes and Fraud Watch! Step forward and claim the dunce cap for our Biggest Bench Blunder of Week 11: StevenStrybos benched quarterback Fernando Mendoza and his 22.88 points while starting Tyler Allgeier for an utterly pathetic 2.3 points against Cowboys.
segments.act: Act IV: Bench Crimes & Fraud Watch

segments.speaker: Comedian
segments.text: [laughs] Sure, losing by 40.7 means Fernando Mendoza was not rescuing StevenStrybos from dmcburney or his 2 and 9 disaster. Still, watching 22.88 rot on your bench while Tyler Allgeier trips over painted turf for 2.3 is pure, museum-grade Sacko cinema that deserves an Oscar.
segments.act: Act IV: Bench Crimes & Fraud Watch

segments.speaker: Analytical Guru
segments.text: Now let us ring the Fraud Watch alarm bells loud and clear. The Boutte Warriors hold second place at 8 and 3 with 1187 points for, yet stumbling to 80.84 against a manager with two total moves exposes a paper-thin floor that contenders should eagerly exploit.
segments.act: Act IV: Bench Crimes & Fraud Watch

segments.speaker: Comedian
segments.text: Forget Boutte Warriors, paint giant red fraud arrows on Drake it til you make it and Loud Submitters! Both teams sit at 7 and 4! EverettWood snuck out a win with 80.22, and Loud Submitters barely cleared 56! Neither roster wants any smoke from ItsOurYear in December.
segments.act: Act IV: Bench Crimes & Fraud Watch

segments.speaker: Analytical Guru
segments.text: [sighs] Johnny is painfully accurate here. ItsOurYear sits sixth at 5 and 6 with 1185.9 points for, virtually identical to 8 and 3 Boutte Warriors! Meanwhile, Drake it til you make it owns 1158.6 points but just burned a massive chunk of schedule luck winning below median.
segments.act: Act IV: Bench Crimes & Fraud Watch

segments.speaker: Beat Reporter
segments.text: [excited] Breaking leak straight from the Week 11 trade desk! In our lone blockbuster deal, jordanzfinci shipped running backs Rhamondre Stevenson and Kyren Williams to Loud Submitters in exchange for draft capital! At 6 and 5, Man-Egg-Ghost-Three just cashed in his chips and started rebuilding!
segments.act: Act V: Transaction Wire & Trade Police

segments.speaker: Comedian
segments.text: [laughs] Hold on! Loud Submitters acquired Kyren Williams and Rhamondre Stevenson, leads the league with 33 transactions, and STILL grabbed Emari Demercado off free agency, dropped Audric Estime, started Demercado for 3.9 points, and scored 56.46?! Thirty-three roster moves just to construct a flaming shopping cart!
segments.act: Act V: Transaction Wire & Trade Police

segments.speaker: Analytical Guru
segments.text: This is textbook over-trading and transaction fatigue. Loud Submitters churns 33 moves to cough up 56.46, whereas Pretty Pattys makes two moves all season and detonates for 116.96. Every time wbruner99 mashes the add-drop button, his projected lineup efficiency plummets by two full standard deviations.
segments.act: Act V: Transaction Wire & Trade Police

segments.speaker: Beat Reporter
segments.text: Wait until you hear jordanzfinci's chaotic quarterback spiral! First, he dropped James Conner to sign Jalon Daniels. Then he immediately dumped Jalon Daniels to add Joe Milton and STARTED Milton for 6.34 points, while newly signed Chimere Dike dropped 10.3 on his bench after cutting Ty Johnson!
segments.act: Act V: Transaction Wire & Trade Police

segments.speaker: Comedian
segments.text: [scoffs] Starting Joe Milton for 6.34 right after selling Kyren Williams! Somebody check if Jordan accidentally handed his phone to a raccoon at three in the morning! Meanwhile, ItsOurYear flexed by dropping Devin Singletary for Kyle McCord, benching McCord's 2.98, and still dropping 140.94.
segments.act: Act V: Transaction Wire & Trade Police

segments.speaker: Analytical Guru
segments.text: Let us lock in the playoff picture across this twelve-team, six-spot gauntlet. K9 KenBoned towers alone at 11 and 0 with 1494.2 points for, over three hundred points ahead of second-place Boutte Warriors at 8 and 3 and third-place Drake it til you make it at 7 and 4.
segments.act: Act VI: Playoff Panic & Sign-Off

segments.speaker: Beat Reporter
segments.text: The real panic lives on the playoff bubble! Fifth-place jordanzfinci clings to 6 and 5 with 1099.2 points after gutting his backfield. Sixth-place ItsOurYear and seventh-place andyehlert sit tied at 5 and 6, though ItsOurYear swamps andyehlert's 962.1 points, while eighth-place Pretty Pattys lurks at 4 and 7 with 942.1.
segments.act: Act VI: Playoff Panic & Sign-Off

segments.speaker: Comedian
segments.text: [laughs] And down in twelfth place, two and nine StevenStrybos with 789.3 points is sprinting toward the Sacko trophy like his trousers caught fire! Start Fernando Mendoza, quit praying for two-point running backs, and maybe keep a fire extinguisher next to your lineup screen this Sunday.
segments.act: Act VI: Playoff Panic & Sign-Off

segments.speaker: Beat Reporter
segments.text: That puts a bow on our Week 11 Playoff Bubble Panic and Fraud Exposure Special for Don't you want a fanta fanta fantasy league! For Johnny Two-Screens and Spencer Dr. Metric Vance, I am Scoop Sullivan. Stop making 33 panic adds, set your starters, and see you Week 12!
segments.act: Act VI: Playoff Panic & Sign-Off
